releaseNotes.zh-CN:
MyCodex 8.1.0 更新日志

• 完善浅色与深色主题，新增“浅色（暖色）”选项；改善选中项和禁用状态的辨识度，修复文字截断、列表内容重叠及部分窗口布局问题。感谢 kl66zhangqiang-lgtm 对主题功能的贡献。
• 新增第三方提供商额度查询，可在认证中心和用户中心查看余额、套餐用量等信息，支持手动和定时刷新；支持 NewAPI、Sub2API、通用接口及自定义脚本，并补充火山方舟和智谱团队版配置。
• 认证中心提供商列表支持上移、下移，可通过右键菜单或 Alt+上/下方向键调整顺序。
• 修复运行时升级后，部分第三方提供商旧会话提示“提供商已不再配置”而无法继续的问题；安全修复时保留原会话和历史，避免重复发送消息。认证后端升级至 0.4.1。
• 更新内置浏览器控制和 Computer Use 组件；修复打开项目目录、Edge、记事本等操作中的组件启动失败，以及与官方客户端配置冲突导致的“未启动桌面客户端”提示。
• 统一自动化任务与普通会话的模型设置，正确保留模型和推理等级；支持“跟随默认”，修复显示、统计及手动续聊误用全局默认值的问题，并保留桌面或手机端修改后的选择。
• 修复部分缺失本地文件路径的残留会话无法删除的问题，完整核实会话状态后允许清理，并保留异常情况和子会话检查。
• 改善连接、WSL 和 SSH 稳定性：修复 App Server 写入卡住后发送或重连持续等待、远程凭据和状态内容被错误写回，以及 SSH 私钥路径含空格时启动失败的问题。
releaseNotes.en-US:
MyCodex 8.1.0 Release Notes

• Improved light and dark theme coverage and added a Light (Warm) option. Made selected and disabled states easier to distinguish, and fixed clipped text, overlapping list content and layout issues in several windows. Thanks to kl66zhangqiang-lgtm for contributing the theme improvements.
• Added usage queries for third-party providers in Authentication Center and User Center, including balances and plan usage, with manual and scheduled refresh. Supports NewAPI, Sub2API, generic endpoints and custom scripts, with additional settings for Volcengine Ark and Zhipu team plans.
• Added provider reordering in Authentication Center through the context menu or Alt+Up/Down.
• Fixed older conversations with some third-party providers failing to resume after a runtime update with a provider-no-longer-configured error. Safe repair preserves the original conversation and history and avoids duplicate messages. Updated the authentication backend to 0.4.1.
• Updated the bundled browser control and Computer Use components. Fixed component startup failures when opening project folders, Edge, Notepad and other applications, and incorrect desktop-client-not-running errors caused by conflicts with official client settings.
• Aligned automation and regular conversation model settings, preserving the selected model and reasoning effort. Added Follow Default support, fixed display, statistics and manual continuation incorrectly using global defaults, and preserved choices made on desktop or mobile.
• Fixed deletion failures for stale conversations without a local file path. Cleanup now verifies conversation state while retaining error and child-conversation checks.
• Improved connection, WSL and SSH reliability. Fixed stalled App Server writes blocking message sending or reconnection, remote credentials and state being written back incorrectly, and startup failures when SSH private key paths contain spaces.
